title: How Tall Is the Family Tree
statement:
A binary tree has `n` nodes numbered `1..n`, and node `1` is the root. For every node you are given its left child and right child, where `0` means there is no such child. The height of the tree is the number of nodes on the longest path that starts at the root and goes down to a leaf. A tree with only a root has height `1`.

## Input
The first line contains `n`. The next `n` lines give the left and right child of node `1`, node `2`, ..., node `n`.

## Output
Print the height of the tree.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 12000`
- The input is a valid binary tree rooted at node `1`.
